decision_conditions:
<p><span style="line-height: 107%;">The proposed incorporation of </span><span style="line-height: 107%;">White Cement Render and Slate Grey Hardie Planks
to the exterior of the development, would appear stark and incongruous, being
of poorer design quality than the Forterra Dark Multi Smooth Facing Bricks and Thermowood
Timber Slats currently proposed under the consented scheme. The use of rendered
blockwork in place of the timber and brick finishes would result in the
building lacking in visual interest and the altered building appearing unduly
at odds with the adjacent brick finished commercial parade that it sits beside,
adversely impacting upon the overall level of visual amenity afforded along the
street scene and within the wider locality. </span><span style="line-height: 107%;">The development would therefore be contrary to
the high quality design aspirations of the </span><span lang="EN-US" style="line-height: 107%;">National Planning
Policy Framework (2023), Policies D3.D(1) and D3.D(11) of The London Plan
(2021), Core Policy CS1.B of the Harrow Core Strategy (2012), Policy DM1 A, DM1
B (b) and (c) of the Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013).</span><br></p>
description: Variation of condition 2 (approved plans) attached to planning permission P/5592/16 dated 22/06/2017 to allow for alternative materials to external fabric
